text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I never expected to pile up
this many losses.
The road to becoming 'the strongest' is so far away, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I already factored in my own weaknesses from the start.
Even so... that stings a bit.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I believed that with you, I could reach "the strongest."
Even though that's what I've worked so hard for...
choice_data_list: We just have to create the best drama from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just when everyone thought, "Royce and Royce is finished..."
She pulled off a dramatic victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Look at it that way, and there's no better situation than this.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's show them, Trainer!
The moment I become the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true.
The reason I've made it this far today is that
I never took my eyes off what it means to be the 'strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I let reality crush me and stop thinking,
I'd be betraying everything I've been up until now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's put our heads together, Trainer!
We'll find a brilliant way to overcome this challenge!
